summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (L9) evaluating whether, after senescent-cell/SASP clearance lowers CD38 load, combining an NAD precursor with a CD38 inhibitor yields residual tissue ΔNAD exceeding the better single-arm alone (a "stack surplus"). The document concludes the claim is NEGATIVE/PREDICTION: no dedicated post-senolysis 3-arm residual panel exists in the literature (UNKNOWN), and the hypothesis predicts no stack surplus (combo residual ≤ max single residual). All supporting evidence is literature-derived; no original experiments have been run.

content_blocks.title: Claim and Hypothesis (L9)
content_blocks.content: The core claim (STATUS: NEGATIVE) is that after documented senescent-cell/SASP clearance lowers CD38 load, residual tissue ΔNAD from a matched NAD-precursor + CD38i pulse does NOT exceed the better single residual arm at a matched timepoint. Pre-registered kill condition: residual_combo ≤ max(residual_precursor, residual_CD38i). This is distinct from L5/L6 residual ranking and L7/L8 single-arm shrink vs alone. The 3-arm residual stack panel remains UNKNOWN in the literature.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Subtract-before-add framework: (1) Clear SASP-driven CD38+ macrophage load first (senolysis/SASP ablation). (2) Pulse three matched residual arms: precursor alone, CD38i alone, precursor+CD38i. CD38 gates age-related NAD decline and NMN fate; SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain tissue NAD; senescent/SASP ablation lowers CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD via an NMN-dependent route; 78c-class CD38i improves aged-mouse healthspan as monotherapy. After subtract, residual levers may be redundant — combo residual ΔNAD need not beat max(single residual).

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
Four key literature references underpin the mechanistic basis:
1. PMID 27304511 (Camacho-Pereira 2016, Cell Metab, DOI 10.1016/j.cmet.2016.05.006, PMC4911708): Age-related NAD decline requires CD38; CD38 is the major in vivo NMN-degrading activity.
2. PMID 33199924 (Covarrubias 2020, Nat Metab, DOI 10.1038/s42255-020-00305-3, PMC7908681): SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that reduce tissue NAD.
3. PMID 33199925 (Chini 2020, Nat Metab, DOI 10.1038/s42255-020-00298-z, PMC8752031): Senescent/SASP ablation ↓CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD NMN-dependently.
4. PMID 35263032 (Tarragó 2022, Aging Cell, DOI 10.1111/acel.13589, PMC9009115): CD38i 78c improves ~10% median survival/healthspan in aged mice as monotherapy — NOT a post-senolysis precursor+CD38i residual stack panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Claimed vs Baseline Measured
content_blocks.content:
Baseline claimed: After senolysis, stacking NAD precursor + CD38i yields residual ΔNAD above the better single residual arm (stack surplus), OR L5–L8 ranking/shrink already settles surplus vs max(single).
Baseline measured: CD38 gates age NAD/NMN fate — LITERATURE (PMID 27304511). SASP→CD38+ macrophages→tissue NAD↓ — LITERATURE (PMID 33199924). Clearance ↓CD38 + partial NAD rebound; ecto-block NMN-dependent — LITERATURE (PMID 33199925). 78c aged-mouse benefit — LITERATURE monotherapy (PMID 35263032). Post-senolysis 3-arm residual panel — UNKNOWN (soft-complete 0). No stack surplus (residual_combo ≤ max single residual) — PREDICTION. L5–L8 do NOT prove this.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat L5–L8 as proving L9 — L5/L6 ranked residual arms; L7/L8 measured single-arm shrink vs alone; combo ≤ max(single) was never the measured claim; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated no surplus.
2. Reviews ≠ kill assay — PMID 36678315 argues potential synergy stacks; it is not a post-senolysis residual 3-arm metabolome.
3. Baseline NAD rebound after clearance and incomplete clearance (residual CD38+ macrophages) can flatten absolute combo ΔNAD or still allow true surplus — assay must pre-register residual vs absolute Δ and clearance verification; 78c monotherapy ≠ stack after subtract.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design (Ablate / Refute / Ask a Human)
content_blocks.content:
Ablate conditions: (1) Remove post-senolysis 3-arm residual panel (precursor/CD38i/combo) with matched timing — without residual factorial vs max(single), solo-lever LITERATURE and reviews cannot show combo lacks stack surplus after subtract. (2) Remove documented clearance run-in with CD38↓/partial NAD rebound verification — without subtract-first confirmation, card collapses into generic precursor+CD38i stacking. (3) Remove L5–L8≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠no-surplus + review≠factorial + residual-vs-absolute discipline.
Refute if: On pre-registered post-senolysis 3-arm residual panel, residual_combo exceeds max(residual_precursor, residual_CD38i) outside no-surplus band (e.g. surplus ≥ 20% of max single, or combo wins pre-registered surplus test) when CD38↓ is verified.
Ask a human: Lock tissue (WAT/liver), clearance verification (CD38 activity + SC/SASP marker), three matched residual pulses (precursor/CD38i/combo), and residual vs absolute ΔNAD definition before claiming no stack surplus; do not treat L5–L8 as proof; no dosing.
